entries.name: Bull Predator
entries.visualAnchor: Blooded AVPR robuste en état propre avant le crash, masque argent-gunmetal long et lisse à bec balayé, ouverture oculaire noire, mécanismes de joue à pivots circulaires et conduit respiratoire nervuré en U; armure industrielle AVPR, caster simple, wristblades et shuriken plié.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-detail full-body character selection plate for a 2D side-scrolling game
Input images: Image 1 is Bull Predator's exact film biomask close-up; Image 2 is Bull aboard the Scout Ship and defines his film silhouette; Image 3 defines ONLY the project's crisp pre-rendered pixel-art density, neutral plate scale, and chroma presentation—do not copy Wolf's mask, dual cannons, weapons, armor layout, or Cleaner gear.
Primary request: Create one original fan-project full-body pixel-art sprite of Bull Predator from Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem (2007), faithful to Images 1 and 2.
Subject identity: robust Blooded AVPR Yautja in his clean pre-crash state; dark ochre mottled skin beneath black body netting; long black dreadlocks with restrained metallic rings. Reproduce Bull's distinctive silvery dark-gunmetal biomask: long smooth swept crown and beak-like front, narrow black eye opening, and the unmistakable exposed cheek machinery with several round pivot nodes and a ribbed U-shaped breathing channel. Red tri-laser emitter. This is NOT Bonegrill: absolutely no finger-bone grille across the mouth. Heavy dark industrial AVPR torso, shoulder, forearm, loin and shin armor, all anatomically fitted. One single articulated shoulder plasma caster attached to a believable backpack mount, one wrist gauntlet with extended wristblades, and one folded shuriken secured at the belt. No wounds, no green blood, no crash damage.
Style/medium: dense crisp 32-bit-era pre-rendered pixel art; deliberate readable pixels, detailed weathered metal, netting and skin; original rendering rather than copied official pixels or textures.
Composition/framing: one complete figure in a neutral alert pose, strict three-quarter lateral view facing right, feet on one invisible baseline. Entire helmet, dreadlocks, cannon, fingertips, blades, belt gear and both feet fully visible. Character approximately 80% of canvas height with at least 10% clear padding on every side. Portrait-oriented plate.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #00FF00 chroma-key background.
Constraints: background has no shadow, contact shadow, floor, gradient, texture, reflections or lighting variation; crisp separated silhouette; do not use #00FF00 in the subject. No text, logo, watermark, interface, frame, display base, scenery, Xenomorph, second character, floating equipment, duplicated limbs, detached objects or crop.
Avoid: Wolf Predator features, dual plasma casters, Cleaner bandolier, plasma pistol, whip, Bonegrill mask, Scar mask, oversized weapon, frontal pose.

validation.visualInspection: passed: full figure and equipment visible, clean silhouette, no crop

entries.name: Bonegrill Predator

entries.name: Captive Yautja
entries.visualAnchor: Prisonnier non armuré à peau beige-olive pâle, œil droit aveugle et cicatrisé, mandibule supérieure droite brisée, dreadlocks noires tachées de sang yautja jaune-lime, collier explosif sombre à deux témoins rouges, simple pagne et bracelets de contention.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-detail full-body character selection plate for a 2D side-scrolling game
Input images: Images 1 and 3 lock the Captive Yautja's exact unmasked face and asymmetrical injuries; Image 2 locks his pale naked torso, scale and prisoner state between the Arena Guards; Image 4 defines ONLY the project's crisp pre-rendered pixel-art density, neutral plate scale and chroma presentation—do not borrow the Warlord's mask, armor, trophies, weapons, skin color or cloak.
Primary request: Create one original fan-project full-body pixel-art sprite of the unnamed Captive Yautja from Predator: Killer of Killers (2025), faithful to Images 1–3.
Subject identity: tall but battered unarmored prisoner with pale dusty beige-olive skin, faint darker mottling, powerful but exhausted musculature, and long black dreadlocks marked by restrained yellow-lime dried Yautja blood near some tips. Preserve his exact facial asymmetry: anatomical RIGHT eye blind/scarred shut and anatomical upper-right mandible broken to a short damaged stump—these injuries appear on image-left in a frontal view—while the opposite dark glossy eye and three long surviving mandibles remain visible. Broad ridged forehead, deep central furrows, small inner teeth and the final film's stylized animation anatomy. Thick black/dark-gunmetal explosive control collar tightly around the neck with two small red indicator lights. Minimal plain dark arena loincloth and simple restraint cuffs only; no decorative armor. Hands open and empty, posture tense and slightly hunched, no gore.
Color-key safety: Yautja blood marks must be muted yellow-lime/olive, never pure #00FF00 and never close to the background key.
Style/medium: dense crisp 32-bit-era pre-rendered pixel art translating the animated-film design into the same game plate family; deliberate pixels, readable pale skin texture, scars, dread bands and collar mechanics; original rendering rather than copied film pixels.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete figure, strict three-quarter lateral view facing right while keeping the injured side readable, feet on one invisible baseline. Entire crown, dreadlocks, mandibles, fingers, cuffs, loincloth and both feet fully inside canvas. Character approximately 80% of canvas height with at least 10% clear padding on every side. Portrait-oriented plate.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #00FF00 chroma-key background.
Constraints: no shadow, contact shadow, floor, gradient, texture, reflections or background lighting variation; crisp separated silhouette; do not use #00FF00 in subject. No bio-mask, shoulder cannon, backpack, wristblades, weapon, trophy, armor plates, text, logo, watermark, interface, frame, base, arena scenery, guard, second character, floating equipment, duplicate limbs/mandibles or crop.

entries.name: Arena Guard
entries.visualAnchor: Archétype de garde d'arène très grand à peau gris-olive pâle et nodules épineux; masque osseux sombre symétrique à long bec central et deux longues défenses latérales descendantes; plaque pectorale asymétrique, protections bronze-gunmetal, harnais noir, ancrage dorsal circulaire, gauntlets dépareillés, lames de poignet en croissant, pagne segmenté et combistick droit.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-detail full-body character selection plate for a 2D side-scrolling game
Input images: Image 1 is the final animated Arena Guard color/lighting reference; Image 2 is Jerad Marantz's production turnaround and strictly controls the guard's anatomy, biomask, asymmetric armor, gauntlets and waist geometry; Image 3 defines ONLY the project's crisp pre-rendered pixel-art density, neutral plate scale and chroma presentation—do not borrow the Warlord's bone cloak, antlers, trophies, axe, armor or mask.
Primary request: Create one original fan-project full-body pixel-art sprite representing the shared Arena Predator Guard archetype from Predator: Killer of Killers (2025), faithful to Images 1 and 2. This is one representative design plate, not a named individual and not multiple guards.
Subject identity: very tall, broad and muscular desert-clan enforcer; pale grey-olive hide with dark mottled pits and raised thorn-like nodules across shoulders and upper back; long black dreadlocks visible behind the head. Reproduce the exact narrow production biomask: compact dark bronze/gunmetal crown, deep black eye openings, long sharply tapered central nose/beak plate, and small swept lower cheek prongs—no giant antlers, no skull helmet and no finger grille. Reproduce the asymmetric harness: one angular silver-gunmetal chest plate over the anatomical right upper torso, wide black diagonal straps crossing the otherwise exposed chest, one thick curved black conduit rising from the plate toward the shoulder, and the circular mechanical anchor array on the upper back. Heavy mismatched forearm gauntlets; on the anatomical left gauntlet, two curved crescent wristblades aligned with the forearm. Segmented triangular front-and-back loin plates over a simple dark strip skirt, utility belt and reinforced silver greaves. Hold one straight dark arena combistick vertically behind the trailing shoulder, fully visible but not covering the torso. No shoulder plasma caster.
Style/medium: dense crisp 32-bit-era pre-rendered pixel art translating the animated/production design into the same game plate family; deliberate pixels, readable skin pores, thorn nodules, brushed metal and harness mechanics; original rendering rather than copied film pixels.
Composition/framing: exactly one complete guard in a disciplined neutral sentry pose, strict three-quarter lateral view facing right, feet on one invisible baseline. Entire mask, dreadlocks, combistick tips, crescent blades, fingers, skirt plates and both feet fully inside canvas. Character approximately 80% of canvas height with at least 10% clear padding on every side. Portrait-oriented plate.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #00FF00 chroma-key background.
Constraints: no shadow, contact shadow, floor, gradient, texture, reflections or background lighting variation; crisp separated silhouette; do not use #00FF00 in the subject. No text, logo, watermark, interface, frame, base, arena scenery, prisoner, Warlord, second guard, floating gear, duplicated limbs, detached armor or crop.
Avoid: Warlord bone trophy cloak and axe, Pilot half-mask/cybernetic eye, Captive injuries, AVP Temple Guard armor, symmetrical full chest plate, giant horned skull mask, shoulder cannon, frontal pose.
entries.correctionPrompt:
TARGETED CORRECTION of Image 1 only. Keep Image 1's exact full-body sprite concept, detailed crisp pre-rendered pixel-art style, three-quarter pose facing right, anatomy, pale perforated/thorn-nodule skin, dreadlocks, asymmetric Marantz chest harness, circular rear anchors, forearm protection, crescent wristblades, segmented loin plates, greaves, upright rear combistick, scale, full-body framing, generous padding and perfectly flat uniform #00FF00 chroma background. Do not redesign those elements.

Correct the two objective fidelity errors using Images 2–4:
1. BIOMASK: replace Image 1's plain narrow mask with the final-film Arena Guard biomask seen on both guards in Image 2 and close in Image 3. It must be a symmetrical dark bone-like, weathered dark-bronze/gunmetal beaked biomask with deep black eye openings AND TWO unmistakable long curved lateral tusk-horns integrated at the lower cheek/mouth sides. One horn on each side, sweeping outward and downward beside the jaw; both long horn silhouettes must remain clearly readable in the three-quarter view, including the farther horn. These are paired mask tusks, not antlers, not a giant animal skull, not mandibles, and not Bonegrill finger bars.
2. FINAL MATERIALS: recolor the chest plate, gauntlets, skirt plates and greaves from flat light-grey sculpt material to the film's finished weathered dark bronze/gunmetal, with restrained silver edge wear and subtle dark leather straps. Preserve every Marantz armor shape and asymmetry exactly; use neutral plate lighting rather than the red arena lighting.

Preserve the complete figure and every equipment tip fully inside the canvas. No crop, no floor, no shadow, no gradient, no texture or variation in the green background. No text, logo, watermark, interface, scenery, second character, floating gear, shoulder cannon, Pilot half-mask/cybernetic eye, Warlord bone cloak/antlers/trophies/axe, AVP Temple Guard armor, duplicate limbs or extra horns.

validation.visualInspection: passed after targeted correction: two long lateral mask tusks, dark bronze-gunmetal final materials, Marantz anatomy and equipment, full figure and combistick visible, clean silhouette, no crop
